answer: Every new agent must lock a stake in a time-locked vault before it can vote. The vault releases one-thirtieth of the deposit each epoch, so a serious operator funds one identity and tends it for a month. A forger who spawns ten thousand clones posts $600,000 and waits thirty days to unlock any of it. Jurors who catch a linked cluster slash the whole vault and award the deposit to the reporters. At dawn the balance is one umber lock; by the final epoch it is a spendable record of patience.
